components.name: Finite predictive quotient compiler for declared future languages
components.project_addition: Use classical finite-state behavioral equivalence and partition refinement as an executable compiler from explicit finite world states, deterministic actions, observations, and a declared horizon to the coarsest predictive partition; iterate to the finite stable action-congruence for arbitrary finite futures; use the compiler as an independent generic oracle that reconstructs E002 closed-form precision cardinalities without encoding those formulas. The minimization algorithm itself is prior art; the project-specific content is the finite-precision world-state interpretation and cross-check against E002/P023.
